nodes.label: ADR-0031 Jobs rule resolvers recompute derived beliefs from parents
nodes.rationale: Derived beliefs (eligibility, fit, reminder, criteria) are arithmetic over structured fields so bench claim C4 needs them to never require a model call; content and structured value are pure functions of parents.
nodes.tradeoffs: A wrong rule is confidently wrong; content formats become a contract between derivation and rules; eligibility asymmetry (no cutoff = eligible, no CGPA = no belief).

nodes.label: jobs_rules() RuleResolver chain (field, eligibility, fit, reminder, criteria)
nodes.rationale: One rule per belief kind (EligibilityRule, FitRule, ReminderRule, CriteriaRule, OpeningFieldRule) with disjoint kinds; returns None when parents in doubt, retire when anchor retired, keep when recomputation equals stored, else update with evidence_refs.

nodes.label: Deterministic rule links for facts recorded later (fit_of, criteria_from)
nodes.rationale: A belief links only to parents it read when derived, so profile.record_profile_fact writes fit_of and criteria_from links for later skills, cgpa and batch.
